### Praise the Lord
Author: Truth For Life
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-july-31-2022.html
Passage: 1 Chronicles 9:33
Points:
- Continuous music in the temple reflected God's ceaseless mercy day and night.
- Believers are constantly indebted to God and should cultivate unbroken gratitude.
- Saints across the earth join together in a perpetual cycle of worship.
- Praise is always fitting because of God's character, providence, and redemption.
- Praising the Lord lightens toil, softens sorrow, and sanctifies daily joys.

### Bible Pathways 05/14/2002
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-05-or-14-or-2002-1133430.html
Passage: 1 Chronicles 9:1-31
Points:
- A faithful remnant left Babylonian comforts to rebuild worship in Jerusalem.
- Seemingly minor tasks like baking bread or counting vessels were essential for worship.
- God records and highly values everyday duties done for His honor.
- Heavenly rewards depend on personal faithfulness rather than human prominence.
- Believers must loyally utilize whatever gifts the Spirit entrusts to them.
